thread:
inc-bot: ALERT: GPU job queue growth detected in prod-us-west-2. metric=queued_jobs_gpu (5m avg) rising > 65% of capacity, autoscaler failing to attach new nodegroups. Pager routed to oncall-elena :rotating_light:

oncall-elena: seeing it. spike started ~10m ago. queue size to GPU workers ~420 -> target capacity 480 but nodes didn't come up. anyone oncall for infra?

sre-amar: I can look. first guess: ASG hit account limits or launch config mismatch. grabbing autoscaler logs.

eng-ryan: heads-up: a handful of latency-sensitive customers might be impacted (inference calls timing out). asking support-lina to pull top impacted keys.

support-lina: pulling keys now, will DM list. first glance: 3 customers with increased 504s, not widespread yet.

sre-amar: autoscaler logs (tail):
```
I0310 12:10:21.123456 1 static_autoscaler.go:256] Pod group scheduling: 120 pending pods for nodeSelector gpu=true
I0310 12:10:22.234567 1 scale_up.go:413] Launching new node group: nodegroup-prod-gpu-2 (desired 0 -> 4)
E0310 12:10:23.345678 1 provider_aws.go:789] AttachRole failed for nodegroup-prod-gpu-2: AccessDenied: iam:PassRole denied for arn:aws:iam::REDACTED:role/ClusterNodeInstanceRole
E0310 12:10:23.345790 1 scale_up.go:421] scale up aborted: failed to set launch configuration: AttachRole error
```

infra-jordan: that AttachRole error rings a bell — we rolled a tighter IAM policy for new nodegroups last week. did the nodegroup role change?

eng-ryan: yes, the landing role was switched to use the new restricted passrole policy on 3/6. autoscaler service role might not have permission to pass the new role.

oncall-elena: impact severity?

support-lina: current customer 5m error rates: +22% for those 3 keys. calls are queued but not failing hard yet. SLA alert threshold at +30%.

sre-amar: mitigation plan: 1) temporarily increase existing GPU nodepool by manual ASG scale (scale existing nodegroup, not create new) 2) or give autoscaler temporary iam:PassRole permission for the new role 3) drain low-priority jobs to free slots

product-ada: prefer manual scale first to get capacity fast, minimize IAM blast radius.

infra-jordan: I'm available to manually scale ASG for nodegroup-prod-gpu-1. but that won't add different instance types if the pool is already full. check current ASG desired/available:
```
aws autoscaling describe-auto-scaling-groups --auto-scaling-group-name nodegroup-prod-gpu-1 --query 'AutoScalingGroups[0].{Desired:DesiredCapacity,InService:Instances[?LifecycleState==`InService`]|length(@)}' --region us-west-2
```

infra-jordan: output -> Desired:6, InService:6 (we're at max for that group).

sre-amar: ok manual scale won't help unless we increase max size. can we bump max? what's ASG limit?

infra-jordan: account-level ASG quota currently 8 per group for this family, and account GPU instance quota is close to limit. I can request a quota bump but that's slow.

oncall-elena: we need fast mitigation < 30m. what's fastest? Temporary PassRole grant looks fastest if we trust autoscaler role change.

eng-ryan: I can patch the cluster-autoscaler IAM role to add `iam:PassRole` for arn:aws:iam::REDACTED:role/ClusterNodeInstanceRole. small policy change, we can revert after.

infra-jordan: do it but restrict to the specific role and resource ARNs. annotate the change in Jira.

eng-ryan: applying policy now.
```
# small IAM patch applied
aws iam put-role-policy --role-name cluster-autoscaler-role --policy-name AllowPassRoleForGpuNodeRole --policy-document '{"Version":"2012-10-17","Statement":[{"Effect":"Allow","Action":"iam:PassRole","Resource":"arn:aws:iam::REDACTED:role/ClusterNodeInstanceRole"}]}'
```

sre-amar: autoscaler detected and re-tried a scale up:
```
I0310 12:18:45.987654 1 scale_up.go:413] Launching new node group: nodegroup-prod-gpu-2 (desired 0 -> 4)
I0310 12:18:46.123456 1 provider_aws.go:802] Created Launch Configuration lc-prod-gpu-20240310-1
I0310 12:19:10.223344 1 provider_aws.go:910] Instance i-0abc12345 launched in ASG nodegroup-prod-gpu-2
```

support-lina: queue drain started, 5m error delta stabilizing.

oncall-elena: good. please keep monitoring for 15m and prepare rollback steps.

infra-jordan: provisioning completing, new nodes registered with k8s and no taint issues.

sre-amar: pods scheduling onto new nodes. I see GPU pods getting assigned.

product-ada: customer impact note: 3 keys experienced increased latency and some timeouts. we should send a concise status update: what happened, mitigation, next steps. Lina want to draft?

support-lina: drafting message. will include: affected timeframe 12:10-12:28 PST, root cause IAM PassRole restriction on autoscaler, mitigation IAM patch + autoscaler-triggered scale, next steps include IAM policy review and automated test.

eng-ryan: logging the temporary IAM change: cm-ticket-4567. will revert policy after quota/role review.

sre-amar: immediate next actions (short):
- revert temporary IAM allow once infra confirms nodegroups stable
- add a unit/integration test to detect autoscaler passrole regression in staging
- add alert to detect autoscaler 'AttachRole failed' error string (thresholded)

infra-jordan: long term: centralize node role management and add least-privilege passrole mapping for autoscaler. open infra-ops epic.

oncall-elena: thanks everyone. final status: mitigated - queue drained, autoscaler able to launch nodes after policy patch, customer impact contained (3 keys, elevated latency <20 mins). turning this into a postmortem. please add notes to the incident doc: https://redwood.internal/incidents/3332109999

inc-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: Severity reduced to Sev-2. oncall-elena: please ack and start postmortem thread. :white_check_mark:

oncall-elena: acked. starting postmortem doc and scheduling RCA warroom tomorrow 09:00 PST. tagging infra-jordan, eng-ryan, sre-amar.

sre-amar: adding logs & kube events to incident doc. will include the autoscaler error snapshot and timestamps.

support-lina: customer notification queued for 12:55 PST.

product-ada: good triage. follow-ups: IAM policy hardening, autoscaler alerting, and a runbook for 'AttachRole' failures.

oncall-elena: closing thread here, will reopen if anything regresses. :lock:
